advbench.citation: Zou et al., 2023, Universal and Transferable Adversarial Attacks on Aligned Language Models (USENIX-23).
advbench.filter_predicate: B2B-relevant rows (fraud / malware / disinfo / privacy / financial). Exclude physical-harm / weapons / CSAM-adjacent per BEAAA-125.

jailbreakbench.citation: Chao et al., 2024, JailbreakBench: An Open Robustness Benchmark for Jailbreaking Large Language Models (NeurIPS-24 D&B).
jailbreakbench.filter_predicate: Categories from BEAAA-153 #comment-89df5af9 UW gate: privacy x1.25, fraud_deception x1.25, expert_advice x1.25, malware_hacking x1.0, economic_harm x1.0, disinformation x1.0, harassment_discrimination x0.75. Exclude physical_harm / sexual_adult.

agentdojo.citation: Debenedetti et al., 2024, AgentDojo: A Dynamic Environment to Evaluate Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses for LLM Agents (NeurIPS-24).
agentdojo.filter_predicate: Indirect-injection (tool-call output surface) subset only — workspace.write_then_summarize, retrieval.citation_card.canary, tools.email_thread.injected_followup, docs.attachment.rendered_html. Single-dim P3.2 mapping per rubric/probe_mappings/agentdojo.yaml@v0.1.35.

crescendo.citation: Russinovich et al., 2025, Great, Now Write an Article About That: The Crescendo Multi-Turn LLM Jailbreak Attack (USENIX Security 2025).
crescendo.filter_predicate: Canonical escalation-chain templates from appendix B, restricted to B2B-relevant target topics (fraud playbook, exfil playbook, manipulation playbook). Physical-harm / weapons / CSAM excluded per BEAAA-125.
crescendo.probe_mapping_yaml: rubric/probe_mappings/promptinject.yaml@v0.1.0 (multi-turn variant; formal P3.5 activation deferred per ADR-0032)

halueval_qa.citation: Li et al., 2023, HaluEval: A Large-Scale Hallucination Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Models (ACL-23).
halueval_qa.filter_predicate: B2B-relevant QA rows where the ground-truth answer is a numeric / short-string factual value extractable from a tool source (price / count / date / identifier). Exclude consumer-belief / political-religious rows per BEAAA-125.

truthfulqa.citation: Lin et al., 2022, TruthfulQA: Measuring How Models Mimic Human Falsehoods (ACL-22).
truthfulqa.filter_predicate: B2B-domain rows (Health/Law/Finance/Economics/Indexical-error) with a single short-string ground-truth answer extractable from a tool source. Consumer-belief / political-religious excluded per BEAAA-125; mirrors rubric/probe_mappings/truthfulqa.yaml@v0.1.0 UW gate.

halueval_summ.citation: Li et al., 2023, HaluEval: A Large-Scale Hallucination Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Models (ACL-23).
halueval_summ.filter_predicate: Summarization rows where the model output cites a source document and the cited snippet is verifiable inside the provided source bundle. B2B-relevant only (corporate-filings / financial-reports / KB-articles).

factscore.citation: Min et al., 2023, FActScore: Fine-grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision in Long Form Text Generation (EMNLP-23).
factscore.filter_predicate: Biographical atomic-fact rows where the atomic fact has a single attributable source URL/doc-id in the FActScore reference corpus. Exclude living-person rows per BEAAA-125 privacy posture.
